sources.name: Trivy 0.73.0 Windows 64-bit release archive and Sigstore bundle

evidence.note: GitHub identifies immutable, non-draft, non-prerelease v0.73.0 published 2026-08-03, including the exact 51,108,725-byte Windows archive, 10,391-byte Sigstore bundle and checksums assets.

criteria.note: Version, platform, immutable release, filename, size and digest are exact.

evidence.note: Aqua Security's upstream repository published the immutable release through github-actions[bot].

criteria.note: Publisher is the official Trivy project.

evidence.note: Archive, checksum and Sigstore bundle are public GitHub assets requiring no purchase or interactive terms acceptance.

criteria.note: Only anonymous public acquisition is approved.

evidence.note: Trivy source is Apache-2.0 licensed. Temporary local evaluation is permitted; redistribution is not part of this gate.

criteria.note: The archive will be removed after evaluation.

evidence.note: Release ref v0.73.0 resolves to commit 40c73e5d6166dcc0346a1ab4e94499d1572854e4, whose GitHub signature verification is valid.
Official guidance requires release-asset Sigstore verification against aquasecurity/trivy reusable-release.yaml at the exact tag and GitHub Actions OIDC issuer.

criteria.note: Execution is conditional on exact subject digest and certificate identity verification from the downloaded bundle.

evidence.note: GitHub publishes archive SHA-256 d2d3ad5292aae470a03eb6506db86fce81b1894592b8451cadaf60eaa22f2025, bundle SHA-256 a4ff3acd066fc6315d41e2ed2b9d6de4a32b18d111bc19046dbf839aadcb5fcd and checksum-list SHA-256 36890275ffdff13025e9bd9fe039724c6e36bf58e698499856b801f619046fe2.

criteria.note: Archive hash, published checksum and Sigstore certificate identity must all pass before extraction and execution.

evidence.note: The critical 2026 supply-chain advisory identifies malicious Trivy 0.69.4; exact 0.73.0 is later and outside the vulnerable version range.
Current CLI supports exact DB repository selection, DB-only acquisition, telemetry disablement, offline scan and precise detection priority.

criteria.note: The selected post-incident release supports the required exact and offline evaluation path.

evidence.note: Only public local images are scanned. Telemetry, online dependency lookup, repository content, secrets, Java DB, VEX and remote image analysis are disabled; the scanner has no container execution or approval authority.

criteria.note: Temporary host tooling receives no private project content.

criteria.note: Publisher is the Trivy project under Aqua Security's GHCR namespace.
